target_device: Tablet landscape (1180px - 1366px primary, responsive down to 390px mobile)
theme: Clean Medical Midnight Blue & Pure White

visual_enhancers.card_styles: bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
visual_enhancers.hero_consultation_button: h-20 w-full md:w-auto px-8 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-sky-600 to-indigo-700 text-white font-bold text-xl shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/25 hover:shadow-sky-500/40 hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-4
visual_enhancers.pulse_recording_badge: animate-pulse bg-red-500/10 text-red-600 border border-red-500/30 font-medium px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs flex items-center gap-2
visual_enhancers.marquee_ticker: bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 py-2 text-xs font-mono overflow-hidden border-b border-slate-800

components.HeaderNav: Includes original SVG logo, product name 'Mediscribe AI', status marquee ticker, doctor profile dropdown, date/time in Italian, and current active clinic switcher.
components.AgendaSection: Tabs or side-by-side columns for 'Studio Centro' and 'Studio Provincia'. Displays timeline appointments with time, patient name, visit type, status badges, and 'Aggiungi Appuntamento' trigger.
components.WaitingRoomSection: List of patients waiting ('Pazienti in Attesa') with status (In attesa, In studio, Completato), wait duration, call-in patient button ('Chiama in Studio'), add/edit/delete patient controls.
components.ConsultationRecordingHub: Huge central recording trigger button ('Avvia Consultazione / Registrazione') with simulated real-time waveform animation, timer counter (00:00), audio pause/stop controls, and audio source selector.
components.AITranscriptionPanel: Live simulated Whisper AI speech-to-text streaming box with speech confidence indicators and manual text correction capabilities.
components.StructuredClinicalNote: Standard medical note template organized into 5 editable sections (Anamnesi, Esame Obiettivo, Diagnosi, Terapia, Follow-up) with copy, save, and print/PDF export actions.

motion.framer_motion_usage: Staggered fade-in on dashboard load, smooth tab transitions between clinics, dynamic scaling on huge consultation button, fluid expand/collapse for structured clinical notes sections.
motion.signature_onload_reveal: Subtle masked reveal SVG animation for the logo icon when the dashboard mounts.

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, note sections, and status badges MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='start-consultation-btn', data-testid='studio-centro-tab', data-testid='patient-waiting-card-1').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion micro-interactions.
Ensure 1180px-1366px landscape tablet experience is primary while preserving full responsiveness down to 390px mobile screens.
All UI strings must be in Italian ('Avvia Consultazione', 'Studio Centro', 'Pazienti in Attesa', 'Anamnesi', 'Esame Obiettivo', 'Diagnosi', 'Terapia', 'Follow-up').
State management must allow adding/editing appointments, managing waiting room queue, toggling recording, streaming AI transcript, and editing/exporting clinical notes.
Use standard lucide-react icons or phosphor-icons.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid default centered templates. Use crisp medical grids with midnight navy tones and pure white clinical surfaces.
Ensure high text contrast complying with APCA / WCAG standards.
Every button and interactive element MUST have hover/active states and data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use emojis as UI icons. Use lucide-react icons.
